final: WITH circuit_race AS (SELECT c.country FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), country_counts AS (SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS country_count FROM circuit_race GROUP BY country), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(country_count) AS total_count FROM country_counts), paired AS (SELECT cc.country_count, 1.0 * cc.country_count / tc.total_count AS ratio FROM country_counts AS cc CROSS JOIN total_count AS tc WHERE tc.total_count IS NOT NULL), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(country_count) AS average_count FROM paired), kept AS (SELECT p.country_count, p.ratio, ac.average_count FROM paired AS p CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac WHERE ac.average_count IS NOT NULL AND p.country_count > ac.average_count) SELECT AVG(country_count) AS average_kept_country_count, AVG(ratio) AS average_kept_country_count_to_total_count_ratio, AVG(country_count - average_count) AS average_kept_country_count_minus_average_count FROM kept
